grammarSchedule.why: a genitive needs two nouns and nothing else, and A1 leaves 1214 of them behind; die Meinung des Kindes is writable in lesson 1. The weak nouns the topic also covers - der Mensch, der Junge, der Kollege - are A1 and A2 words, so both halves are reachable at once

werden is an A1 verb and the infinitive can be any verb already taught, so this topic costs no vocabulary at all. Lesson 2 supplies wahrscheinlich and vielleicht, which is what a prediction is usually hedged with
nachdem is the conjunction that makes the earlier-of-two-past-events reading unambiguous, and no level of the bank carried it until lesson 42 adds it. hatte and war are A2
a passive needs a transitive verb whose object is worth promoting; lesson 12 brings verbessern, verändern and entwickeln, whose objects are exactly what a report talks about
the construction says what must or may be done to something, so it needs the vocabulary of obligation: erlauben, verbieten and gestattet arrive together in lesson 31
the contrast with the werden-passive only shows on a verb with a visible result state. lösen in lesson 18 gives the cleanest pair: das Problem wird gelöst against das Problem ist gelöst
wäre, hätte and würde need no new words, but a counterfactual needs something to be counter to. Lesson 19 supplies Gelegenheit, Chance, Fall and falls, which is where the hypothetical sentences live
the relative pronoun is the definite article the learner already has, and any noun can be its antecedent. Lesson 1's Meinung, Gedanke and Rat are all nouns a sentence wants to qualify
the wo variant needs a place worth naming twice. Lesson 52 brings Büroraum and Büroalltag, so das Büro, wo ich arbeite is writable without leaning on A1's Stadt for every example
a zu-clause needs a governing verb that takes one. erwarten and annehmen arrive in lesson 13, alongside A2's hoffen, versuchen and entscheiden
the topic is its connectors. entweder...oder and je...umso both land in lesson 41, and weder...noch and sowohl...als auch follow in lesson 42
obwohl, während, bevor and damit are A2, but sodass was missing from every level until lesson 42 adds it. seitdem, the sixth of the set, does not arrive until lesson 240

A2 taught the endings that follow an article; the bare form needs adjectives that sit naturally in front of an uncountable or plural noun. Lesson 8's verschieden, allgemein, natürlich and sozial are all of that kind
the topic is the verb, not the preposition. abhängen von and konkurrieren mit arrive in lesson 5, sich beschweren über in lesson 4, and each one is useless without its preposition
two pronoun objects need a verb that takes two objects. anbieten in lesson 5 is the first B1 one, and A1's geben and schicken carry the rest
trotz arrives in lesson 39 and wegen in lesson 42; während and außerhalb are A2. Lesson 39 is where the first of the four becomes writable
als and wie are A1 words, but a comparison needs two things worth comparing. Lesson 20 is built on exactly that: Unterschied, vergleichen, vergleichbar, gleich
als for a single past event needs a past to point at. Lesson 36 supplies Vergangenheit, Jahrhundert, Jahrzehnt and neulich, and the Präteritum itself is A2
